channel.title: NEO-IDT Knowledge Base
channel.description: Last 10 notes on NEO-IDT Knowledge Base

item.title: Stakeholder Conflict Resolution
item.description: According to the Freeman 1984 stakeholder identification framework, audit the explicit records and resolution strategies for conflicts among multiple parties' needs

item.title: Sustainability Metrics Coverage
item.description: Against the triple bottom line (Elkington 1997), audit the quantified targets and data disclosure of the environmental dimension

item.title: Dark Pattern Audit
item.description: Audit manipulative design according to the Mathur et al. 2019 taxonomy (countdown pressure/fake inventory/hidden cancellation/forced bundling)

item.title: Inclusive Market Positioning Audit
item.description: Audit the explicitness of the inclusive value proposition in product positioning (target-population coverage statement/differentiation statement/accessibility capability disclosure)

item.title: Inclusive ROI Framework
item.description: Audit the quantified record of inclusion investment (compliance cost/development investment) and the benefit framework (market size/retrofit avoidance/brand value), against ROD 2024 market data

item.title: Gender Inclusivity Completeness
item.description: Audit the neutrality of gender fields, the configurability of salutations/pronouns, and the neutrality of sizing systems; invite transgender/non-binary users to validate

item.title: Data Collection Minimisation
item.description: Audit whether the personal information the product collects aligns with core-function necessity — an application of GDPR Article 5(1)(c) data minimisation (adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary) and the PIPL minimum-necessity principle

item.title: Privacy Control Completeness
item.description: Audit permission granularity, data deletion/export entry points, guest mode and retention policy, and verify the response time for user rights requests
